rules.answer_text: Right, so — I was down the alley end around then. Saw someone in a blue coat come in from the square about a quarter to... no, closer to ten-to. Went towards the cafe's back door. Didn't see the face but — that's Mitchell Thorne's coat, everyone knows it. And later there was this thud from inside. Dull, like a sack of flour going over. I didn't think anything of it. You don't, do you.

rules.answer_text: So it's true. someone. She promised me that expansion two years ago — I built my plans on it. If you're asking whether I was angry: yes. Angry enough to demand a meeting. Not angry enough for... whatever you're implying. I was with someone when it happened, ask him.

rules.answer_text: Eight thousand. There, I've said the number. They'd have ruined me by lunchtime and called it principle. But I was in my yard with Col when it happened, and thank God for that delivery, because I know how this looks.
